text:
incident-bot: PAGING — p99 router egress latency spike in eu-west-2, streaming stalls observed. Trigger: p99 > 800ms for 3m. Bridge: https://zoom.company/incident-3724681357. Paging @oncall-night and eng-runtime. Initial note: routing policy misassignment suspected causing hot shard fanout. Please join bridge and acknowledge.

alyssa: on it, joining bridge now. grabbing dashboards and logs.

samir: quick snapshot — p95 jumped 210ms -> 460ms, p99 peaked ~1.12s. Heatmap shows heavy fanout to shard 42 and increased cross-zone egress. Grafana: https://grafana.company/d/abcd/router-eu-west2

megan: FYI we rolled a balancing weight bump earlier at 01:20 UTC (policy v3a) to reduce cross-zone tail for a test. Could be related. @julia any rollout to routers?

julia: we did not push router config directly, but the rebalancer job executed at 01:19:54 (job id rb-2026-01). It adjusted assignment weights across shards to rebalance traffic. I’ll pull the job logs.

keith: customer impact: Support ticket #12345 (AcmeCorp) reporting streaming stalls + disconnects; initial spike correlates with their sessions in eu-west-2 — they saw ~4% session disconnects at 01:22 UTC. Adding them to bridge.

ev an: KV cache hit-rate dropped 87% -> 34% for routes hitting model x-small when misrouted. Hypothesis: misrouting pushed traffic to cold shard causing KV churn and tail. I can trigger a targeted warmup if we want.

oncall-night: acknowledged. On bridge. Proposed immediate actions: 1) remove weight for shard 42 in router policy to force fallback, 2) enable eager fallback to dedicated pool for streaming routes, 3) warm shard 42 cache, 4) monitor p95/p99 and customer error rate. Samir, can you update weights?

samir: running weight update now:
```
curl -XPOST https://router-api.internal/api/v1/policies/weights -d '{"shard":42,"weight":0}'
```
Updating... done. Router API returned 200. Pushing change took ~6s.

ops-bot: alert: eu-west-2 p99 latency decreased from 1.12s -> 720ms (approx 30s after weight update).

megan: enabling eager fallback for streaming routes now (tradeoff: cost). Done, config id ef-3724 applied.

ev an: kicking off shard warmup:
```
go run infra/tools/warm_shard.go -shard=42 -concurrency=20 -until=hitrate>=0.6
```
Warmup started. KV hit-rate climbing to ~65% after 90s.

alyssa: seeing streaming stalls reduce on bridge logs. AcmeCorp ticket shows disconnects drop to ~0.8% over last 5m. Nice.

product-lead: AcmeCorp is on a S2 contract, CSM wants an update. Keith please notify and offer timeline for postmortem.

keith: pinged CSM and AcmeCorp rep, sent interim update. They reported immediate improvement and requested root-cause & mitigation plan.

julia: posting follow-up: rebalancer job did an aggressive assignment for shard 42 because of a noisy weight metric; there's no hot-shard safeguard. Filing PR to add thresholding and a cooldown (PR: https://git.company/rebalancer/pulls/518).

megan: monitoring — p99 currently ~420ms, p95 ~180ms. We'll keep actions in place until stable for 30m. Open tasks: postmortem, add rollout guardrails for policy jobs, add a canary step that simulates hot-key distribution.

ev an: note for runtime team — add metric for 'per-shard kv-eviction-rate' to early-detect cold-shard misroutes.

oncall-night: confirming incident state: mitigated for customer impact (AcmeCorp saw improvement). Keeping incident open for stabilization. If p99 < 400ms and error rates remain <0.5% for 30m, we can resolve.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 3724681357 — status: mitigated (partial). Severity P1 -> monitoring. Bridge closed at 01:37 UTC. Runbook: https://confluence.company/incidents/3724681357. Postmortem assigned to eng-platform + eng-runtime.

megan: adding retrospective note — revert weight zeroing only after confirming rebalancer fix. Also let's add an automatic rollback to previous policy if p99 increases by >200% within the first 5m of rollout.

keith: customer follow-up scheduled; AcmeCorp asked for timeline and will await postmortem. I'll include timeline and interim mitigations.

julia: PR opened for rebalancer safeguards. I'll add unit tests & a canary gating job.

samir: thumbs up — once PR merges we'll schedule safe rollout. For now keeping fallback/routing patch in place.

megan: closing note — thanks all for quick responses. Key takeaways: rebalancer needs hot-shard safety, router policy rollouts need short canaries, and add per-shard KV eviction alerts.

incident-bot: final log artifact: https://logs.company/3724681357. Marks: unresolved action items moved to #incidents-tasks.
